public_rationale: The evidence supports the ordinary reading that engineering limitations remained one contributor to AI reliability problems. DeepMind described difficulty applying established assurance methods in 2019. The May 2024 article identifies a continuing mismatch between conventional coverage methods and learned systems. This is evidence of a persistent problem, not evidence that engineering made no progress. The documented practices in e3 and the alternatives discussed in e2 limit that stronger interpretation.
limitations: The causal assessment synthesizes technical explanations; it is not a controlled estimate of engineering's contribution to failures.
The evidence concerns machine learning and autonomous systems, rather than every kind of complex AI system.
Support depends on reading 'hasn’t really changed' as persistence of inadequacy, rather than absence of substantial improvement.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Struggles with complex AI systems stem partly from a lack of adequate techniques for engineering complex systems, which has not really changed since 2019.

statement.excerpt: As Ernie Davis and I pointed out in Rebooting AI, five years ago, part of the reason we are struggling with AI in complex AI systems is that we still lack adequate techniques for engineering complex systems. That hasn’t really changed.
statement.document_title: Don’t look up: the massive Microsoft/Crowdstrike data outage is a huge wake-up call

from_speaker: struggling with AI in complex AI systems
lack adequate techniques for engineering complex systems
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that limitations in engineering methods contributed to AI reliability problems in 2019 and remained a contributing factor by July 19, 2024.
Adequacy means practical ability to test, debug and assure complex AI systems under their intended operating conditions.
Persistence of this problem does not require that no useful techniques existed or that no progress occurred.
The comparison begins in 2019, the year indicated by 'five years ago'; January 1 is a boundary for that unspecified baseline year.
criteria.support_condition: Research identifies limitations in engineering methods that contribute to difficulties assuring complex AI systems in 2019, and documents continuing limitations of that kind by July 2024.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Research shows that the relevant engineering limitations had been substantially overcome by July 2024, or that the claimed difficulties arose without a material contribution from limitations in engineering methods.
